title: 十一點五十的鐘聲
subject: the four-auntie kitchen team at a Tainan primary school cooking 1,200 lunches against the 11:50 bell: steamers stacked to the ceiling, ladles swinging in choreography, and one auntie shouting class numbers as the soup buckets roll out, until the bell rings and she finally sits down with her own bowl
caption: 1960s Motown-style soul sung in Mandarin, the Detroit sound as revived by Taiwan's R&B-funk-jazz bands. Tambourine and snare hitting every beat; a busy melodic electric bass in the Jamerson style; a chiming tremolo electric guitar; a stabbing horn section of trumpet, tenor sax and baritone sax; an upright piano pounding chords; a vibraphone tinkling over the chorus. Mono-leaning vintage mix, tight room, light tape saturation. Female alto lead, warm and gritty, punchy gospel-tinged phrasing, girl-group backing vocals answering each hook line. 126 BPM, B-flat major. Bustling, cheeky, racing the lunch bell. No trap drums, no autotune, no modern R&B runs, no synth bass, no EDM.
lyrics:
[Intro - tambourine and snare on every beat, horn stab, bass walk-up]

[Verse 1]
早上六點 台南的小學 廚房門打開
四個阿姨 圍裙一綁 蒸籠疊得比人還高
一千兩百份午餐 三杯雞配高麗菜
秀琴阿姨的大鍋鏟 炒得像在跳舞

[Pre-Chorus]
十一點五十 鐘聲就要響
誰都不准 慢半拍

[Chorus]
三年五班 湯桶好了沒
四年二班 白飯來了
阿姨喊一聲 鍋鏟轉一圈
鐘聲響以前 一桶都不能少

[Verse 2]
蒸籠一開 白煙衝上天花板
玉蘭阿姨打菜 每一勺都一樣多
小朋友趴在窗外 偷看今天吃什麼
阿姨說 吃光光 明天多一顆滷蛋

[Chorus]
六年一班 湯桶好了沒
一年三班 水果來了
阿姨喊一聲 鍋鏟轉一圈
鐘聲響以前 一桶都不能少

[Bridge - horns drop out, bass and handclaps]
十一點四十九 推車排成一列
四個阿姨 擦一擦汗 對看一眼

[Chorus - backing vocals full]
鐘聲響了 一千兩百份 全部到了
走廊上一千兩百聲 謝謝阿姨
秀琴把鍋鏟 靠在牆上
坐下來 吃她自己那一碗

[Outro - horns and tambourine vamp, cold stop]
